schedule_count.title: Times per day
schedule_count.description: How many times a day this should be done. The next step asks for each time.

schedule_times.title: Times of day
schedule_times.description: Set the time of each execution.

schedule_interval.title: Every X hours
schedule_interval.description: The first term is exactly the start you set in the next step; each following one comes this many hours after the previous.

schedule_range.title: Start, end and tolerance
schedule_range.description: The schedule runs between the start and the optional end. A press this many minutes before or after a term counts as on schedule.

legend.title: How to read the card
legend.description:
Every schedule has one button. The **colour and the sentence under the name** tell you what to do:

- **Green** — “You are up to date” / “All according to plan”. The last term was confirmed.
- **Fading to red** — “The time is coming”. The next term is approaching.
- **Red** — “NOW”. A term is due: press the button (inside the tolerance window it counts as on time).
- **Blinking black** — “WARNING - overdue!”. A term was not confirmed in time: press the button and answer the question — A: it was done but not recorded, B: it was not done and you are doing it now, C: it was done and this is an additional one.
- **Red with a black number** — “Done too many times”. More executions today than planned.
- **Grey** — “Switched off” or “Not started yet”. The schedule takes no presses. A switched-off schedule (or one past its end) is hidden on the dashboard and shows grey only while you edit it; switch it back on in the card editor.

The **big number** is how many times it was done today. If it **blinks** (“Blinking number: the last execution was recorded outside the schedule”), the last press was outside the schedule.

**Pressed between two terms?** When nothing is due and the coming term's tolerance window has not begun, the card asks whether this is the coming occurrence, only done now (it counts for that term, the button goes on from green and the schedule's next point is the one after it), or an extra one.

**Sound, text size, contrast:** in *Global settings* choose the default reminder sound and its volume, the text size of the cards and high contrast. Each schedule can have its own sound and volume.

reset_schedules.title: Reset to "all on time"
reset_schedules.description: Sets the chosen schedules to the state where everything due so far today was done on time. Say it is 2 pm and the cat should have been fed at 7: the counter becomes 1, the button lights up as it should, and today's history gets a normal entry at 7:00. Today's earlier entries of these schedules are replaced; earlier days stay as they are. Schedules that are switched off or have not started are skipped.

global_settings.title: Global settings

data.high_contrast: High contrast (white bold text on black)

global_settings.description: Each schedule can have its own sound and volume (set when you edit it). The volume is relative to the volume of your device.

error.end_before_start: The end must be later than the start

options.remove: Remove this schedule and its entity

options.already_done: It was done at that time, it just was not recorded
options.do_now: It was not done then - I am doing it now
options.extra: It was done then, and this is an additional one
options.done_early: It is the coming occurrence, done now (it counts for the coming term)

answer_required.message: Pressing outside the tolerance window while a term is still open needs an answer (already_done, do_now or extra).

schedule_not_active.message: This schedule is not active (before its start, after its end, or switched off).

invalid_time.message: Not a valid time. Use 24-hour HH:MM.

too_many_times.message: A schedule can have at most 24 times a day.

invalid_interval.message: The interval must be between 0.5 and 48 hours.

invalid_datetime.message: That date and time cannot be read.

end_before_start.message: The end must be later than the start.

invalid_window.message: The tolerance window must be between 1 and 240 minutes.

wrong_mode.message: That field does not apply to this schedule's mode (times are for fixed-times schedules, the interval for every-X-hours schedules).

nothing_to_update.message: Give at least one field to change.

early_answer_required.message: This press falls between two terms and needs an answer (done_early: the coming occurrence done now, or extra).

invalid_volume.message: The volume must be a whole number from 0 to 4.

press_schedule.name: Press schedule
press_schedule.description: Confirm a schedule programmatically (the same as pressing its button on the card).

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Needed when pressing outside the tolerance window while a term is still open, or between two terms (the answer_required attribute is true, or early_by_seconds is set). Values: already_done, do_now, extra, done_early.

clear_history.name: Clear history
clear_history.description: Clear a schedule's press history, entirely or for specific ISO weeks.

weeks.name: Weeks
weeks.description: ISO week strings (e.g. 2026-W41). Omit to clear the whole history.

update_schedule.name: Change a schedule
update_schedule.description: Change a schedule's name, description, times, interval, start, end or tolerance window. Switching its mode is done in the integration settings.

fixed_times.name: Times
fixed_times.description: Fixed-times schedules only: the times of the day as HH:MM (1-24 of them).

end_at.name: End
end_at.description: Leave empty to remove the end.

sound_id.name: Reminder sound
sound_id.description: One of the sound ids, or "default" to use the default of the integration.

reset_schedule.name: Reset to "all on time"
reset_schedule.description: Sets a schedule to the state where everything due so far today was done on time: the counter matches the terms that have come due and today's history gets a normal entry for each of them (earlier days stay as they are).

set_schedule_active.name: Switch schedule on or off
set_schedule_active.description: Switch a schedule off by hand (grey button, no alerts, no missed entries) or back on.
